_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja CaptainsQuarters/Kajuta Kapitana (136 terminow, ~30 mikroscen) - sypialnia Mortugi, dostepna przez rozbudowana sekwencje fabularna (alarm cisnienia, ucieczka Grippa, model miasteczka z ukryta latarnia, Czarna Skrzynka niemozliwa do otwarcia w tym miejscu gry).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci. Fragmenty w [i] w scenie SubmarineInDanger (ds7/ds9) to zniekstalcone/urwane kwestie w chaosie alarmu - przypisane kontekstowo do Sally/Grimoire kontynuujacych swoje zdania.

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Alarm.en: We have to get to the Control Room!!
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Alarm.pl: Musimy dostać się do Centrali Dowodzenia!!
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Alarm.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_BG/Se.en: Technically, if it's the [h]Captain's[/h] Quarters, whoever is currently Captain would get this room.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_BG/Se.pl: Technicznie rzecz biorąc, skoro to Kajuta [h]Kapitana[/h], to ten pokój należałby do tego, kto obecnie jest kapitanem.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_BG/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.en: There [i]must[/i] be a way to get this open...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.pl: [i]Musi[/i] być jakiś sposób, żeby to otworzyć...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.en: ...I wonder if there was something we missed in [i]Mariana's[/i] room? You know - the Cargo Hold?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.pl: ...zastanawiam się, czy czegoś nie przegapiliśmy w pokoju [i]Mariany[/i]? No wiesz - w Ładowni?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.en: We'll just have to hope we stumble across the answer somewhere else.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.pl: Będziemy musieli mieć nadzieję, że natkniemy się na odpowiedź gdzie indziej.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.en: You know, we should [i]probably[/i] listen to that new tape we found...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.pl: Wiesz, [i]chyba[/i] powinniśmy odsłuchać tę nową taśmę, którą znaleźliśmy...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.en: Maybe there [h]is[/h] a way to open it after all...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.pl: Może jednak [h]jest[/h] jakiś sposób, żeby to otworzyć...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.pl: W końcu udało nam się to otworzyć.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.en: There's no way to open it.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.pl: Nie ma sposobu, żeby to otworzyć.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Black.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Curta.en: Should we put the curtain back?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Curta.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Curta.en: There's an old curtain hanging up here.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Curta.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Curta.en: Wanna take a look behind it?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Curta.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Doorw.en: ...but this door's made of thick metal.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Doorw.pl: ...ale te drzwi są zrobione z grubego metalu.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Doorw.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Doorw.en: Most of the room is made of wood...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Doorw.pl: Większość tego pokoju jest zrobiona z drewna...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Doorw.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Doorw.en: I guess now we can get outside...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Doorw.pl: Chyba teraz możemy wyjść na zewnątrz...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Doorw.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Gripp.en: What's he gonna do - should we [i]follow[/i] him? I don't-
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Gripp.pl: Co on zamierza zrobić - powinniśmy go [i]śledzić[/i]? Ja nie-
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Gripp.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Gripp.en: Can you see him through the window?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Gripp.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Gripp.en: Wait - what's that on the floor...?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Gripp.pl: Czekaj - co to jest na podłodze...?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Gripp.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Jacke.en:
It's an old jacket.
It's made of tarpaulin - or something similar.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Jacke.pl:
To stara kurtka.
Zrobiona z brezentu - albo czegoś podobnego.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Jacke.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Jacke.en: For going out in the rain.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Jacke.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Model.en: Hey, there's a panel at the front... and it slides out.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Model.pl: Hej, z przodu jest panel... i wysuwa się.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Model.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Model.en: I guess that's the ocean. You can put the little model boats on it.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Model.pl: Chyba to ocean. Można na nim ustawiać małe modele łódek.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Model.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Model.en: The little lighthouse... it opened up. And there's something in there...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Model.pl: Mała latarnia morska... otworzyła się. I coś tam jest...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Model.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Subma.en: This is bad - the pressure change, it's too sudden-
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Subma.pl: To źle - zmiana ciśnienia, jest zbyt nagła-
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Subma.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Subma.en: It must be coming from the Control Room!
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Subma.pl: To musi dochodzić z Centrali Dowodzenia!
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Subma.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Subma.en: [i]-the pressure's too much, it was too fast-[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Subma.pl: [i]-ciśnienie jest za duże, było za szybko-[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Subma.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.en: For once, I'm glad to hear it.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.pl: Tym razem cieszę się, że to słyszę.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.en: And what would happen if it had the wrong pressure? The door would burst open?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.pl: A co by się stało, gdyby ciśnienie było złe? Drzwi by się wyważyły?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.en: Oh, I imagine the glass would break, at least.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.pl: Och, wyobrażam sobie, że przynajmniej szkło by pękło.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.en: The submarine must be pressurised on the inside to offset the external water pressure...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.pl: Łódź podwodna musi być ciśnieniowana od wewnątrz, żeby zrównoważyć zewnętrzne ciśnienie wody...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.en: I mean - that's a good thing, right?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.en:
I can see an old wooden deck...
It looks a bit like a pirate ship.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.pl:
Widzę stary drewniany pokład...
Wygląda trochę jak statek piracki.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.en: I guess now we can get outside...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.pl: Chyba teraz możemy wyjść na zewnątrz...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_Windo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_ceili.en: Yeah. I don't think we're in the submarine anymore.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_ceili.pl: Tak. Chyba nie jesteśmy już na łodzi podwodnej.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_ceili.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_chair.en: What's that hanging on the back the chair? Socks?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_chair.pl: Co wisi na oparciu tego krzesła? Skarpetki?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_chair.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_drawe.en: I can't get the drawers open.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_drawe.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_drawe.en: I think the wood just rotted.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_drawe.pl: Myślę, że drewno po prostu zgniło.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_drawe.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_dress.en: Like... a [i]woman[/i] would have in her bedroom?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_dress.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_lante.en: It's been a while since it was lit...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_lante.pl: Minęło trochę czasu, odkąd była zapalona...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_lante.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_umbre.en: It's falling apart... it looks ancient.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsQuarters_umbre.speaker: Sally
